Theorem — Rayleigh quotient
    
      For $n\ge1$ and $A\in\mathbb S^n$: $\ \lambda_{\max}(A)=\max_{\|x\|=1}x^\top Ax$, $\ \lambda_{\min}(A)=\min_{\|x\|=1}x^\top Ax$, and $\lambda_{\min}\|x\|^2\le x^\top Ax\le\lambda_{\max}\|x\|^2$ for all $x$, with equality at the corresponding eigenvectors.
